title: City on ocean with roads made of docks
content: I have dreams pretty often of this city on the coast and there's grid-like roads made of wooden docks on the ocean and there's like traffic lights coming out of little concrete pyramid things in the water and lots of house boats and floating restaurants with sailboats drifting past in the distance. It's always kind of foggy and a little chilly out, but I dream of driving through this part in a convertible with the top down, and it's just chill and peaceful and there's lots of other cars driving about. You can see like miles and miles of grid-like docks of city blocks made of wooden docks people are driving on. Outside this there's a part where the road divides and splits apart between I guess eastbound and westbound lanes which circle around a huge sign for the city. I think it says "West Titus" or something like that, and then it kind of goes up a hill and winds around and there's restaurants and stores on tiers going up like huge terraces, set up like a giant staircase. Seems like a modern city of around 100,000, but set up half on the ocean and the part with most stores and restaurants seems like its set up for walking only. Like there's a sidewalk to a Wendy's rather than a road, like you're intended to park somewhere else and walk through the commercial district. The whole on-land part of the city is set on a hill so you can look up and see pretty much every business and where it is from the docks. Anybody else experience something like this?
